text:
Alex: quick micro-standup for the gateway team — routing policy / auth / rate limits.
- What I did: landed policy refactor for service-tag precedence, updated unit tests.
- Blocker: one e2e flake around JWT rotation that fails intermittently during canary.
- Today: pair with @Jess at 14:00 to run canary rules, open follow-up to add migration flag for policy precedence. :coffee:

Jess: 14:00 works for me. saw the flake in CI — stack shows 401 while key rotated, might be a race in auth middleware. quick note: replicated locally once.

Ravi: merged the rate-limit header change (X-Rate-Tier). noticed route fallback logic ignores `tier=dedicated` header for some requests — probably priority sorting bug. will investigate.

Olga: blocked on QA for canary verification — staging traffic mirror is giving `connection refused` on the ingress forwarder. re-run smoke tests now.

Deploy Bot: Canary deploy started: edgeflow-v3 -> 25% traffic. logs: `deploy/edgeflow-v3: canary roll 25% -> stable` :rocket:

Maria: quick question — if we change policy precedence order, do we need a migration window for customers with custom routing rules? TL;DR: probably yes, need a config toggle and doc note.

Alex: @Maria good call — add a `policy_migration_mode` flag and default to `off`. we'll announce in release notes. also add a short migration doc under docs/gateway/policies.

Ravi: I'll take the header+priority repro. posting minimal repro below, saved me time earlier:
```
# repro: send request with tier header, then rotate routes
curl -H "X-Rate-Tier: dedicated" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://staging-gateway.internal/api/v1/echo
# observe if the request routes to specialized pool
```

Jess: opened a tiny PR to add flaky retry for the e2e auth test in the harness (link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/987). helps unblocking CI while root cause is investigated.

Olga: re-run smoke passed. QA: canary routing stable at 25% for 10m -> proceeding to 50% once @Alex + @Ravi give thumbs. :thumbsup:

Alex: summary: PRs mostly ready, pairing at 14:00, @Ravi to debug tier-header routing, @Jess to look at JWT flake with retry as temporary mitigation. If anything urgent, ping #oncall or DM. Thanks — short sync later after pairing. :v:
